description: This is a Java interface defining a logging system component called LogNode. It specifies the method 'println' for outputting log data, allowing different implementations to handle log messages and exceptions, potentially creating chains of log nodes.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: A basic interface for a logging system that can output to one or more targets. It allows chaining of log nodes and defines the 'println' method for logging messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Defines how a log message with a given priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable should be outputted by implementations of LogNode.
